recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It completes the remaining source-level wording from FHIR-17473 without reopening later-approved current element names or adding redundant guidance beyond stale descriptions that could mislead implementers.
issue_request: FHIR-17473 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FM change request for STU3 that asked to adapt EligibilityRequest for Da Vinci CRD coverage-requirements discovery. The accepted resolution used CoverageEligibilityRequest.purpose for the request type, broadened the resource scope to validation, discovery, benefits, and authorization requirements, renamed/detail-neutralized service items, added item.detail references, and added supporting information with item-level linking.
initial_application: Historical commits 5fc36d59f7 and 5ca058130a applied the old spreadsheet and introduction changes for purpose values, supportingInformation, item/detail structure, billcode naming, and expanded CoverageEligibilityRequest narrative scope. Later source refactoring generated the current StructureDefinition XML, renamed EligibilityRequest to CoverageEligibilityRequest, and maps old billing-code/service names to current productOrService naming.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists CoverageEligibilityRequest as an active approved build resource and maps it from EligibilityRequest. The current source already has the required purpose, supportingInfo, supportingInfo.appliesToAll, item.supportingInfoSequence, item.productOrService, and item.detail elements. The remaining problem was that the current StructureDefinition description and relationship-table copies still used older eligibility-only wording about validity and insurance details. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting work-group record.
reconciliation: Updated the active CoverageEligibilityRequest StructureDefinition description/root definition and related CoverageEligibilityRequest/CoverageEligibilityResponse narrative table rows so they describe validation, discovery, benefits, and preauthorization requirements. Left the already-correct structural elements and current productOrService naming unchanged.
source_changes: source/coverageeligibilityrequest/structuredefinition-CoverageEligibilityRequest.xml: updated the StructureDefinition description and root definition to include coverage validation, discovery, benefits, and preauthorization requirements.
source/coverageeligibilityrequest/coverageeligibilityrequest-introduction.xml: updated the CoverageEligibilityRequest relationship-table description to match the expanded scope.

source/coverageeligibilityresponse/coverageeligibilityresponse-introduction.xml: updated relationship-table descriptions for the request/response pair to avoid repeating the stale eligibility-only wording.
